about.story: Born from a passion for traditional Japanese culinary techniques, Shinjuku Restaurant has brought the Tokyo dining experience to the heart of New York since 1986. We believe in the beauty of simplicity and the integrity of ingredients.
about.chef: Master Chef Kenji Sato brings four decades of experience from the legendary kitchens of Ginza. His philosophy is rooted in 'Washoku'—the harmonious fusion of ingredients.
about.heritage: Our space is inspired by the Wabi-Sabi aesthetic, celebrating the beauty in imperfection and the passage of time. Every bowl and plate is chosen to tell a story.
